free_tier.stated: ModelScope and AMD run a developer incentive programme. Step 0 is registering for the AMD AI Developer Program through the ModelScope Notebook page, which pays 100 hours of AMD GPU notebook time. Content paths stack on top: 25 hours per approved technical article capped at 50, 50 hours per approved notebook capped at 150, and 700 hours or more for an approved deployed application, which the vendor states totals 1,000 hours or more. The vendor page names MI300X only as an example AMD option and states no core, memory or VRAM figure; the machine shape is in free_tier.notes as a user-reported figure.
free_tier.notes: standing quota for each new user on the vendor notebook page: PAI-DSW GPU 8 cores, 32GB RAM, 24GB VRAM with 36 hours free quota, and EAIS GPU 8 cores, 32GB RAM, 16GB VRAM with 64 hours free quota; the AMD incentive hours in the statement above are a separate one-time grant; AMD notebook shape, reported by a user from their own console and not stated on the vendor page: 8 cores, 200GB RAM and 192G VRAM, with amd-smi showing 196288 MB total, ISA gfx942 (CDNA 3, Instinct MI300 series) and 80 compute units, a slice of a full MI300X rather than the whole card

retention.stated: the 100 hours are a one-time grant that only ticks while the instance runs, a single boot is capped at about 8 to 10 hours, and only files under /workspace persist, so the 192 GB card is reachable in 8-hour slices; the harder wall is that the ModelScope notebook needs a real-name-verified Alibaba Cloud account linked.

identity_cost.detail: national-id: the notebook requires authorising and linking an Alibaba Cloud account, and 'an Alibaba Cloud account requires real-name verification', quoted from a third-party guide rather than a vendor page. The student route is narrower again: a full-time student at a mainland China university, on an account already through individual real-name verification, completed by Alipay scan, valid 30 days and stopping on graduation. No card requirement, hold, debit or prepaid statement appears in any evidence row: unknown.

Every new user gets a free initial GPU allowance of 36 hours, a single instance run capped at 10 hours, 100 GB of free persistent storage, and a recorded check date of 2026-10-02; the page cites modelscope.cn/docs/notebook/intro as the vendor source.
Alibaba Cloud developer community post headlined 300 hours of free GPU for students with an edu email, linking to modelscope.cn/brand/view/GPU.
Binding an Alibaba Cloud account also gets 100 hours of free GPU compute on ModelScope Notebook, the smaller figure that recurs across Alibaba's own posts.

The Alibaba Cloud student identity check requires a full-time student at a mainland China university and an account already through individual real-name verification, completed by Alipay scan; verification lasts 30 days and stops working on graduation.
